resolution.note: bin/krn ci logs prints failed-job log tails across every run attempt; proven on captures of run 42486987437

title: Print failing job logs across every attempt of a CI run
body:
Outcome: one command prints the failing step's tail for a PR's required Check across every run attempt, so the lead never reads a cancelled re-run attempt instead of the attempt that failed.
Evidence: t-s6tq5ay diagnosis; run 42486987437 attempt 2 was cancelled and gh run view --log-failed showed only the aggregate Check, while the rejection sat in attempt 1 job 128750929767; finding it took six gh calls.
Acceptance: bin/krn ci a log subcommand (or an extension of krn ci) given a run id lists each attempt's failed jobs and prints the last N lines of each failed step; a test drives it against a verbatim capture of the GitHub jobs API.
